about.title: Who builds your product
about.personalStory: We take projects end to end, from the first idea to production. You work directly with the people building your software, with no layers of middlemen and no unnecessary handoffs.
about.teamNote:
We keep the team small and bring in trusted specialists when the project calls for it.
That means senior attention without the heavy structure of a large agency.
about.newChapter:
Based in Córdoba, Argentina, working with teams across the US, Canada, and Europe.
We build custom software and automations for businesses whose operations have outgrown spreadsheets and manual processes.
